description: Cancels the user's appointment by booking_id, as returned by list_current_bookings. Returns ok=true with cancelled set to that booking_id, or ok=false with a reason: not_found (no such appointment for this user) or bad_id (not a valid UUID). A cancellation is reversible — the freed slot can be booked again — which is why this tool is not marked destructive. To change the time instead of giving the appointment up, reschedule moves it atomically within the same day. Authorization required: the one-time Telegram OAuth consent (scope booking:write), which also covers later calls.

booking_id.description: UUID of the appointment, exactly as list_current_bookings returned it.

name: cancel
